name: Betty
source:
Betty is the owner and shop attendant at Ashley's Boutique (it was named after the former owner, whom Betty inherited it from), a local women's fashion store. Allison is a frequent customer as is Amy. Amy is also friends with Betty.

Betty is a big beautiful woman (BBW) who immediately takes a liking to the Main Character.

She later helps him get a wardrobe overhaul.
